newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: MINISTER TO GO TO FRANCE TO TALK TELECOMMS.
newsitem.headline: MINISTER TO GO TO FRANCE TO TALK TELECOMMS.

text.p: Lithuanian European Affairs Minister Laima Andrikiene will leave for France on Sunday for a four-day visit which will include talks on the privatisation of Lithuanian Telecomm.
The ministry said in a statement that Andrikiene will meet with officials from France Telecomm to dicuss the privatisation plans of Lithuanian Telecomm.
Lithuanian Telecomm is one of a group of key state assets which the current government has vowed to sell-off.
A number of international investment banks have been invited to Vilnius next month to participate in a conference on the privatisation of Lithuanian Tellecom.
